content:
Apple has released macOS 27.2 beta 3 to developers, and a day later it is now also rolling out the corresponding build to users signed up for the public beta program. Here is a roundup of what's new.

macOS 27.2 public beta 2 now available

After a two-week gap, Apple seeded macOS 27.2 beta 3 to developers yesterday, continuing testing on a system that is expected to see a general release in the coming weeks.

While the iOS 27.2 betas have introduced several new features, including a redesigned Health app, a dual-camera mode for Group FaceTime calls, and Apple TV personals in the TV app, macOS 27.2 has seen relatively few changes, and its main feature is the addition of five new languages for Siri AI.

As the company revealed at last month's iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo event, Siri AI will add support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish, joining it as a supported language alongside English.

macOS 27.2 public beta 2 ships with build number 26B5101f, the same as yesterday's release.

If you want to sign up for Apple's free public beta program, head to beta.apple.com.

Have you spotted anything new in this beta? Drop us a line in the comments.
